description:
Check-only module (ships nothing). Simulates a third-party app that depends on BOTH
        arcadedb-engine and the plain arcadedb-gremlin coordinate (no classifier). Two checks:
        1) maven-enforcer asserts antlr4-runtime 4.9.1 is NOT exported transitively by
           arcadedb-gremlin (issue #5217); gremlin's antlr must stay <optional>true</optional>
           so the only antlr edge in a both-modules consumer graph is the engine's 4.13.2.
        2) A single IT (see GremlinPlainJarConsumerIT) actually resolves and runs on that exact
           classpath, using TinkerPop's fluent Java API (GraphTraversalSource), to guard the
           embedded, no-classifier consumption path against #5879: arcadedb-network was reachable
           only through the provided-scoped arcadedb-server, so RemoteDatabase (referenced on the
           ordinary embedded query path, not just for remote usage) threw NoClassDefFoundError for
           every consumer of the published artifact. Textual/string-based Gremlin queries (the
           ArcadeDB QueryEngine SPI, e.g. analyze()/command("gremlin", ...)) are deliberately NOT
           exercised here: TinkerPop's precompiled grammar parser is generated by ANTLR 4.9.1 and
           cannot initialize under the engine's ANTLR 4.13.2 runtime that this same classpath
           requires, so that path needs the relocated arcadedb-gremlin:shaded classifier instead
           (tracked separately, see GremlinPlainJarConsumerIT for details).
        Must build after arcadedb-gremlin in the reactor.
